primary_method_sources.title: Rescaled bootstrap for stratified multistage sampling
primary_method_sources.author: John Preston
primary_method_sources.implementation_scope: Single-stage stratified SRSWOR special case; floor(n/2) within each sampled stratum, nonnegative weights. Does not reproduce original SIPP multistage PSUs.

primary_method_sources.title: Rao-Wu Bootstrap in surveysd
primary_method_sources.scope: Official package formula checked; n-1 with-replacement rescaled bootstrap is a sensitivity, not preferred for all large-fraction strata.

primary_method_sources.title: Concentration inequalities for sampling without replacement
primary_method_sources.scope: Theorem4.3; empirical SD denominator n; one-sided failure5delta; two-sided stratified union uses delta=alpha/(10J).

primary_method_sources.title: Doubly Robust Estimation in Missing Data and Causal Inference Models
primary_method_sources.scope: Attribution for mature AIPW principle. Double robustness does not validate missing-at-random, positivity or this implementation under unrestricted nonresponse.
